name: event-command-center
description: Monorepo foundation for the Real-Time Event Operations Command Center capstone.

scripts.format: prettier --write package.json backend frontend database/prisma7.config.ts eslint.config.mjs .github/workflows/checks.yml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json backend frontend database/prisma7.config.ts eslint.config.mjs .github/workflows/checks.yml
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=backend && npm run typecheck --workspace=frontend
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=backend && npm run test --workspace=frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend
